newsitem.title: USA: Emeritus expects lower third qtr earnings.
newsitem.headline: Emeritus expects lower third qtr earnings.

text.p: Emeritus Corp said on Thursday it expected its earnings for the third quarter as well as the 1996 calendar year to be "substantially" below analyst expectations.

The company, which specialises in senior housing services, blamed faster growth, increased overhead expenses, greater emphasis on ownership rather than leasing of communities, and slower fill-up of vacant units for the lower than expected results.
Although it did not provide any figures, Emeritus reported an $819,000 net loss for the second quarter, against an $1.8 million loss for the same period the previous year.
